notes: Simplified three signals into urgent pain, private worries and end-of-life decisions. Removed commentary about the reading experience. Humor targets business incentives while treating suffering respectfully.
Every spoken sentence independently checked against the canonical English source for clear purpose, intended viewer response, source fidelity and natural spoken wording.
All scenes remain compact, with one sentence per clip and specific restrained delivery directions. Viewer responses are editorial intentions, not results from audience testing.

sentenceIntentions.text: What happens when helping you get better means losing you as a customer?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Open with the conflict between recovery and revenue.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel an immediate, understandable tension in a helping business.

sentenceIntentions.text: Aspirin, Viagra, and Coffins uses dark humor to explore businesses built around human pain.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the book, tone and subject.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect serious inquiry with humor rather than a medical guide.

sentenceIntentions.text: Some needs are urgent, some feel too private to discuss, and others arrive at the end of life.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Explain the three title signals plainly.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand why these apparently unrelated markets belong together.

sentenceIntentions.text: The title opens a serious conversation about loneliness, exhaustion, shame, and the help people seek.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Keep the people and their needs central.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel respect for the people whose problems create these markets.

sentenceIntentions.text: A useful service can bring relief while its business depends on the problem continuing.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See how genuine relief and problematic incentives can coexist.

sentenceIntentions.text: The book follows that tension through research, care, and the growing market for AI companions.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Give a specific reason the book matters now.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to examine what AI companionship changes.

sentenceIntentions.text: Its jokes make room for questions that polished sales pitches tend to avoid.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Explain the value of the book’s tone.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel invited into an uncomfortable subject without being mocked.

sentenceIntentions.text: If a product promises to help, what should success look like for the person using it?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: End on the reader’s own standard for help.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Consider whose outcome a promise of help should serve.
